title: Execute every DAO Origin canonical vector against the production validator and manager
description: P2 test correctness: python/tests/test_vectors.py still says no production DAO-origin codec exists and evaluates all 51 dao_origin_signature.json cases only through a second handwritten parser. The production DaoOriginValidator is exercised for just five source-binding cases, so stage/reason divergences such as E=1 being rejected structurally instead of semantically remain green. Build a production-vector harness covering malformed parse outcomes, identity, signature, replay ordering, semantic rejection, persistence, reconciliation, and accepted route state for every canonical case while retaining the independent oracle checks.
